assessment: Wu et al. establish the role of Ciona X-box binding protein (Xbp1), a basic leucine zipper transcription factor, in notochord morphology, in downstream gene regulation providing novel targets and as an evolutionarily conserved feedback interactor with Bra as shown in Xenopus. The manuscript is well written and suggests a conserved regulatory subcircuit between Xbp1 and Bra in Ciona and Xenopus.
